The [[Zaishen Challenge (outpost)|Zaishen Challenge]] is a [[Player versus Environment|PvE]] [[challenge mission]] designed in the style of [[Player versus Player|PvP]].

[[Unlock]]ed for the [[account]] by completing the [[Training Arena]].
